title: Outreach — Baker Road Baptist Church
metaDescription: The Pumpkin Patch, the Easter SONrise service, rides to church, missionary support, and helping neighbors in Baytown.
headline: Baytown is our first mission field.
intro: Most of it looks like opening the parking lot and putting the coffee on.

sections.note: “For even the Son of Man came to serve, not to be served.” — Mark 10:45

items.title: The Pumpkin Patch
items.body: The church lot becomes a pumpkin patch, open to all of Baytown. Come pick out a pumpkin. That is the whole invitation.

items.title: The SONrise service
items.body: Easter starts on the patio before the sun is up, with acoustic worship and the Lord's Supper. Breakfast afterward, then the regular service at 10:15.

items.title: A ride to church
items.body: No way to get here? Call the office by Friday and we will do our best to arrange a ride for Sunday.

items.title: Neighbors in need
items.body: If you need help, or you know someone who does, call and ask.

items.title: Open-door events
items.body: Game nights, church-wide meals and seasonal gatherings. The kind of thing you can bring a neighbor to without warning them first.

items.title: Missionaries
items.body: Supported through the cooperative work of Southern Baptist churches, and since the beginning.

items.title: Help with any of it
items.body: The Pumpkin Patch alone takes dozens of people across two weeks.
